collection_instructions: On the NAS host, export the running admin-worker environment without secrets when possible: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker-compose.yml exec admin-worker env | sort > admin-worker.env
On the NAS host, export container metadata: docker inspect $(docker compose --env-file .env -f docker-compose.yml ps -q admin-worker) > admin-worker.inspect.json

Copy those files into a local evidence folder and run: MIXLAB_ADMIN_WORKER_ENV_FILE=<path>/admin-worker.env MIXLAB_ADMIN_WORKER_INSPECT_JSON=<path>/admin-worker.inspect.json npm run validate:admin-worker-env-proof
Do not paste secrets into chat. The report records only required flags, library roots, image, and container name.

gates.title: Worker env proof has no Docker or NAS side effects
gates.evidence: This report reads exported evidence files only; it does not contact Docker, restart containers, enable workers, or write NAS files.

gates.title: Exported admin-worker env file provided
gates.required_evidence: Provide an exported admin-worker.env file from the NAS host.

gates.title: Exported admin-worker inspect JSON provided
gates.required_evidence: Provide docker inspect JSON for the running admin-worker container.

gates.title: Exported env file keeps standalone workers disabled
gates.required_evidence: Both standalone admin-worker flags must be 0 before Docker release gates allow upload or staging.

gates.title: Running container keeps standalone workers disabled
gates.required_evidence: Both standalone admin-worker flags must be 0 before Docker release gates allow upload or staging.

gates.title: admin-worker uses Docker library roots
gates.required_evidence: Running admin-worker must use /data/PublicLibrary for both Admin and preprocess library roots.

gates.title: Running admin-worker image is observed
gates.evidence: No running image was observed in docker inspect evidence.
gates.required_evidence: docker inspect evidence must include the running admin-worker image.

result.summary: admin-worker environment proof is missing or unsafe; Docker upload remains blocked.
